description: The account's brand kit for Marketing Studio: logo, colors, fonts, voice, tagline and selling points. action import + url reads them from the brand's website (logo, palette and fonts from the page, the voice and claims from its words) and saves it; get shows it; update changes fields (colors as #RRGGBB, logo_url must be a PixelDojo upload). Free. Once set, every pixeldojo_ad, pixeldojo_campaign and pixeldojo_marketing call applies it automatically.

fonts.description: Up to two brand font names.

logo_url.description: A logo on PixelDojo (upload it first); PNG with transparency is best.

save.description: import: false returns the kit without saving it. Default true.

url.description: import: the brand website, e.g. yourbrand.com.

voice.description: How the brand talks, one or two sentences.

name: pixeldojo_brand_kit
title: Brand kit from website
